projects.title: PocketDesk
projects.shortDescription: Your offline-first, privacy-respecting productivity ecosystem built with Flutter.
projects.customReadme:
# 📱 PocketDesk

**Your offline-first, privacy-respecting productivity ecosystem.**

PocketDesk is a production-quality, offline-first productivity hub built with Flutter. It combines a full-featured **Calendar**, **Task Manager**, **Notes Ecosystem**, **Wallet Health**, and an **AI Companion** into a single, beautifully designed application — without requiring a cloud account or internet connection.

> 🔒 **Privacy Guarantee**: You own 100% of your data. Everything runs locally on device storage. Internet connection is only utilized for local peer-to-peer device sync and optional AI integrations.

---

## ⚡ Core Feature Modules

### ⏰ Clock & Timers Hub
- **Native Alarms**: Full alarm system with custom labels, repeat schedules, enable/disable toggles, and local push notifications.
- **Interactive Timers**: Countdown timer with quick duration chips (1m, 5m, 10m, 15m), custom duration pickers, and audio completion alerts.
- **Stopwatch**: High-precision stopwatch built for split times and productivity sessions.

### 📅 Calendar & Events
- **Multi-View Engine**: Day, Week, Month, Year, and Agenda views.
- **RFC 5545 Rules**: Native support for complex recurring events, color coding, and reminder notifications.
- **ICS Import & Export**: Seamlessly import and export `.ics` calendar files offline.

### 📝 Note Ecosystem & AI Notes
- **Rich Note Editor**: Auto-saving rich notes with attachments, drawing canvas, code syntax blocks, and checklists.
- **AI Formatting**: Instantly format, summarize, or clean up notes offline.

### 💰 Money Health & Expense Manager
- **Financial Breakdown**: Monthly expense tracking, starting balance vs. spending, and category percentage bars.
- **AI Financial Score**: Automated Spending Score (out of 100) with custom savings advice quotes and targets.

### 🤖 PocketDesk AI & Local Security
- **AI Companion**: Integrated assistant powered by OpenRouter API with custom system prompts for 24/7 feature help.
- **Security Recovery**: 2-step registration with Argon2id password hashing and recovery security questions.

---

## 🛠️ Platform Support & Specs

| Platform | Status | Engine |
|:---|:---:|:---|
| **Android** (API 24+) | ✅ Supported | Flutter 3.24 + Isar NoSQL |
| **Linux Desktop** | ✅ Supported | GTK3 + Native C++ Embedder |
| **Windows / macOS** | 🔜 Planned | Cross-Platform Build Target |

projects.title: Nagar Sampark
projects.shortDescription: Offline-first government IT directory & employee finder created during Government On-the-Job Training.
projects.customReadme:
# 🏛️ Nagar Sampark (नगर सम्पर्क)

**Offline-First Public Government & Official Directory Application**

Developed during my **Government On-the-Job Training (OJT)** internship, Nagar Sampark provides citizens and staff with instant, offline access to verified contact details for municipal employees, elected officials, emergency services, and public departments.

> 💡 **Public Impact**: Created to eliminate communication bottlenecks in municipal government offices by making contact information accessible without relying on active internet connectivity.

---

## ⚡ Core Feature Highlights
- 🇳🇵 **Bilingual Interface**: Seamlessly accessible in both **English & Nepali**.
- ⚡ **100% Offline Access**: All directory records are pre-indexed and embedded locally for instant search without cellular data.
- 🔍 **Smart Multi-Attribute Search**: Fast filtering by official name, designation, municipality ward, department, or phone extension.
- 🔒 **Zero Telemetry**: Built with zero user tracking, zero advertisements, and no mandatory login accounts.

---

## 📂 Open-Source Public Dataset
Due to government IT security guidelines, the application source code remains private. However, the structured public contact database is open-sourced:
👉 [Explore Nagar Contact Data Repository](https://github.com/Aaryanbanskota/nagar-contact-data)

projects.title: Bloom Terminal
projects.shortDescription: A sleek, customizable Python terminal suite & developer CLI tool.
projects.customReadme:
# 🌸 Bloom Terminal

**A sleek, customizable Python terminal suite & developer CLI workspace.**

Bloom Terminal elevates your command line workflow with aesthetic rich-text styling, ASCII banners, built-in system diagnostics, and developer automation tooling.

---

## ⚡ Key Highlights
- 🎨 **Rich Terminal Aesthetics**: Color themes, customizable ASCII startup banners, and animated progress loaders.
- ⚡ **Developer Suite**: Instant system health metrics, environment variable inspectors, and fast file utilities.
- 🧩 **Modular Plugin System**: Write custom Python scripts to extend terminal commands effortlessly.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Clone repo
git clone https://github.com/Aaryanbanskota/Bloom-terminal.git
cd Bloom-terminal

# 2. Run Terminal Suite
python3 main.py
```
